```yaml
name: Dependabot Auto-Merge

on:
  pull_request_target:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ["Only CI/CT"]
    types:
      - completed

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write
  checks: read

jobs:
  auto-merge:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: >-
      github.event_name == 'pull_request_target' &&
      github.event.pull_request.user.login == 'dependabot[bot]' ||
      github.event_name == 'workflow_run' &&
      github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Get PR details for workflow_run
        if: github.event_name == 'workflow_run'
        id: pr_details
        run: |
          # Find the PR associated with the workflow run
          # This requires fetching the commit SHA and finding the PR
          COMMIT_SHA=${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}
          PR_NUMBER=$(gh pr list --search "$COMMIT_SHA" --json number --jq '.[0].number')
          
          if [ -z "$PR_NUMBER" ]; then
            echo "No PR found for commit $COMMIT_SHA"
            exit 0
          fi
          
          echo "PR_NUMBER=$PR_NUMBER" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          
          # Check if the PR is from dependabot
          PR_AUTHOR=$(gh pr view $PR_NUMBER --json author --jq '.author.login')
          if [ "$PR_AUTHOR" != "dependabot[bot]" ]; then
            echo "PR $PR_NUMBER is not from dependabot[bot]"
            exit 0
          fi
          
          echo "PR_AUTHOR=$PR_AUTHOR" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Get PR details for pull_request_target
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request_target'
        id: pr_details_target
        run: |
          PR_NUMBER=${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          PR_AUTHOR=${{ github.event.pull_request.user.login }}
          echo "PR_NUMBER=$PR_NUMBER" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "PR_AUTHOR=$PR_AUTHOR" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Set PR variables
        id: set_vars
        run: |
          if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" == "workflow_run" ]; then
            echo "PR_NUMBER=${{ steps.pr_details.outputs.PR_NUMBER }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "PR_AUTHOR=${{ steps.pr_details.outputs.PR_AUTHOR }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "PR_NUMBER=${{ steps.pr_details_target.outputs.PR_NUMBER }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "PR_AUTHOR=${{ steps.pr_details_target.outputs.PR_AUTHOR }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Wait for status propagation
        if: github.event_name == 'workflow_run'
        run: sleep 5

      - name: Check PR status and merge
        id: check_and_merge
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ steps.set_vars.outputs.PR_NUMBER }}
          PR_AUTHOR: ${{ steps.set_vars.outputs.PR_AUTHOR }}
        run: |
          # Validate PR author
          if [ "$PR_AUTHOR" != "dependabot[bot]" ]; then
            echo "Skipping: PR author is not dependabot[bot]"
            exit 0
          fi

          # Check if PR is already merged
          PR_STATE=$(gh pr view $PR_NUMBER --json state --jq '.state')
          if [ "$PR_STATE" == "MERGED" ]; then
            echo "Skipping: PR is already merged"
            exit 0
          fi

          # Get check runs for the PR
          CHECK_RUNS=$(gh api repos/${{ github.repository }}/commits/${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha || github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}/check-runs --jq '.check_runs')
          
          # Check if there are any check runs
          CHECK_COUNT=$(echo "$CHECK_RUNS" | jq 'length')
          if [ "$CHECK_COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then
            echo "Skipping: No check runs found"
            exit 0
          fi

          # Check for failed or cancelled checks
          FAILED_CHECKS=$(echo "$CHECK_RUNS" | jq '[.[] | select(.conclusion == "failure" or .conclusion == "cancelled")] | length')
          if [ "$FAILED_CHECKS" -gt 0 ]; then
            echo "Skipping: Found failed or cancelled checks"
            exit 0
          fi

          # Check if all checks are completed
          INCOMPLETE_CHECKS=$(echo "$CHECK_RUNS" | jq '[.[] | select(.status == "completed" | not)] | length')
          if [ "$INCOMPLETE_CHECKS" -gt 0 ]; then
            echo "Skipping: Some checks are not completed yet"
            exit 0
          fi

          # Check if all checks are successful
          SUCCESSFUL_CHECKS=$(echo "$CHECK_RUNS" | jq '[.[] | select(.conclusion == "success")] | length')
          if [ "$SUCCESSFUL_CHECKS" -ne "$CHECK_COUNT" ]; then
            echo "Skipping: Not all checks are successful"
            exit 0
          fi

          # Auto-approve the PR
          echo "Approving PR $PR_NUMBER"
          gh pr review $PR_NUMBER --approve

          # Auto-merge the PR with squash merge
          echo "Merging PR $PR_NUMBER"
          gh pr merge $PR_NUMBER --squash --auto
```
